messages:
isabel: Morning! Quick heads-up: the cookie tin on the counter appears to have a new secret society of crumbs. If you nabbed the last batch please leave a note. Also: who can bring a compact cooling rack? The cooling area is full. :cookie::mag:
matt: Not me, but I can bring a small rack at 11. Also vote: cookies tonight or tomorrow? I vote tonight.
tina: I'll vote tomorrow  my oven schedule is chaotic today. Also can we please stop microwaving paper bags? Saw a faint scorch mark.
owen: Oof paper bags = bad idea. Agree on rack. I'll add a tiny printed sign for the cookie tin: `Please label: name | date | free to eat after` so we know owners.
julia: Also can we have a compact cookie-crumb brush for the counter? Tiny brush = big dignity. I'll bring one. :broom:
kitchen-bot: Poll created: "Cookie timing" options: Tonight, Tomorrow. Poll ends 2023456900. Shopping list updated: compact cooling rack, crumb brush. Reminder scheduled: "Return cooling rack" 2023460800.
matt: Poll cast: Tonight. If people want warm cookies at 4pm I can reheat gently.
tina: Cast: Tomorrow. Also reminder: if you heat chocolate, use double boiler or microwave 15s bursts. We had a choc meltdown last week.
isabel: Great notes. If tonight wins maybe we do a tiny taste test: salted vs unsalted butter. Also tiny etiquette ask: please don't stack mugs on top of the toaster  they keep sliding.
owen: Mug stack PSA noted. I'll tape a tiny "no mugs" sign on toaster at lunch.
julia: Cookie coronation rules: label, cool on rack, crumb brush, share. Loser of the poll buys milk. :milk_glass:
kitchen-bot: Reminder: "Cookie coronation" event created for 2023458000. Shopping list unchanged.
matt: OK I'll grab a small rack and the milk if tonight wins. If tomorrow wins I'll reschedule. Thanks y'all. :cookie:
